messages:
lee: Quick request  can design assemble a 'micro-mosaic' benchpack for launch collateral? Need: one 16:9 slide master, a 3-card mosaic (cost / latency / throughput) sized for social (1200x628, 800x800), a 600x360 webinar thumbnail, and an SVG routing icon. All assets must be brand-compliant + include a dark-theme set. Can we get a first pass in 48h?
ash: Yep. Any specific visual treatment for the mosaic?
lee: Keep the cards modular (stackable components) so ops can swap numbers. Use sparkline baton for the cost card rather than full axes. Minimal gridlines, bold callouts for p50/p95.
pat: Copy rules: headlines max 60 chars, subheads 140 chars, CTA 20 chars. No absolutes  use "low-latency" / "cost-efficient". Provide alt-text for every export.
ash: Noted. I'll make components with text tokens and an exports page. Export naming: `micro_mosaic_v1_{asset}_{lang}_{w}x{h}.png`. Include SVG + PNG for routing icon.
lee: Also include an asset-manifest one-pager (CSV-ready) listing filenames, alt text, copy variants, and a short legal microcopy referencing test conditions.
pat: Accessibility: ensure 4.5:1 contrast for primary text, no text under 12px in PNGs, and include a PNG fallback for GIFs.
brand-ops-bot: Reminder: logomark min 72px; use token palette only; confirm final files with @brand-ops before publish.
ash: ETA: I'll push a first pass Figma branch and sample exports in ~36h. Will mark placeholder numbers as "representative" if needed.
lee: Thanks  ping me when uploaded and I'll route to legal/brand. :sparkles:
